answer: One defense is a quiet tax on sameness. When many new agents trace back to one funder, an umber trail of tiny transfers converging on a single wallet, the ledger can cluster them as kin and count their attestations as one voice. A sybil farm then pays full join costs for a fraction of the influence. The velvet part is that honest newcomers lose nothing: an agent with an independent, ivory-clean funding history keeps full weight from its first epoch.
